Name: Boot Speed Scaling
Author: Shtompeld
Description:
Boot Speed Scaling
[b]Make your boots more useful![/b]
Boot Speed Scaling is a lightweight, configurable mod for Stardew Valley that adds a movement speed bonus to your equipped boots based on their existing Defense and Immunity stats.
Better boots can now make you move faster, giving footwear progression an additional purpose without introducing new items, crafting recipes, or complicated upgrade systems.
[heading]Features[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Stat-based movement speed:[/b] Boots provide additional movement speed based on their Defense and Immunity values.[/*]
[*][b]Fully configurable:[/b] Adjust how much speed each point of Defense and Immunity provides.[/*]
[*][b]Fractional bonuses:[/b] Small bonuses such as +0.2 and +0.35 are supported.[/*]
[*][b]In-game tooltips:[/b] The calculated speed bonus appears directly in the boots' item tooltip.[/*]
[*][b]Automatic updates:[/b] Speed bonuses are recalculated when you equip, replace, or remove boots.[/*]
[*][b]Vanilla-friendly:[/b] The mod preserves the original Defense and Immunity stats.[/*]
[*][b]Buff-based implementation:[/b] Uses the game's buff system to apply the movement speed bonus.[/*]
[*][b]Optional GMCM support:[/b] Configure the mod through Generic Mod Config Menu.[/*]
[*][b]Localization:[/b] English and Russian included.[/*]
[/list][heading]How It Works[/heading]
The speed bonus is calculated using the following formula:
[code]Speed Bonus = Defense × Defense Multiplier + Immunity × Immunity Multiplier[/code]By default, both multipliers are set to [b]0.1[/b].
Examples with the default configuration:
[table][tr][th]Defense[/th]
[th]Immunity[/th]
[th]Speed Bonus[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td]1[/td]
[td]1[/td]
[td]+0.2[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]2[/td]
[td]1[/td]
[td]+0.3[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]3[/td]
[td]3[/td]
[td]+0.6[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]4[/td]
[td]4[/td]
[td]+0.8[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]7[/td]
[td]0[/td]
[td]+0.7[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]These values represent additive movement speed bonuses, not percentage increases.
The bonus is calculated from the stats of the equipped boots only. Other equipment, food, and temporary buffs do not contribute to this calculation.
[heading]Configuration[/heading]
The mod has two configuration options:
[b]SpeedPerDefense[/b]
Default:
[code]0.1[/code]Determines how much movement speed is gained per point of Defense.
[b]SpeedPerImmunity[/b]
Default:
[code]0.1[/code]Determines how much movement speed is gained per point of Immunity.
Example
[code]config.json[/code]:
[code]{
  "SpeedPerDefense": 0.1,
  "SpeedPerImmunity": 0.1
}[/code]Set either multiplier to
[code]0[/code]to disable its contribution.
You can configure the mod using Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM), or edit
[code]config.json[/code]manually.
GMCM is optional. The mod works without it.
[heading]Requirements[/heading]
[b]Required:[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[*]SMAPI (compatible 4.x version)[/*]
[/list][b]Optional:[/b]
[list]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu[/*]
[/list]Content Patcher is not required.
[heading]Installation[/heading]
[b]Using Vortex:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download this mod using Mod Manager Download.[/*]
[*]Enable the mod in Vortex.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b]Manual installation:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download the mod archive.[/*]
[*]Extract the mod folder into
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code].[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][heading]Compatibility[/heading]
Designed for Stardew Valley 1.6 and its compatible SMAPI versions.
The mod uses the game's buff system for movement speed and Harmony to extend boots' item tooltips.
Mods that heavily modify item tooltips may affect how the additional speed line is displayed.
Multiplayer and compatibility with every third-party interface mod have not been fully verified.
[heading]Uninstallation[/heading]
Remove Boot Speed Scaling from your Mods folder or disable it using your mod manager.
The mod does not add new boots or change their base Defense and Immunity stats. Removing the mod removes its additional speed functionality.
[heading]Feedback and Bug Reports[/heading]
If you encounter a problem, please include:
[list]
[*]Your Stardew Valley and SMAPI versions.[/*]
[*]The Boot Speed Scaling version.[/*]
[*]A description of the issue and how to reproduce it.[/*]
[*]Your SMAPI log, preferably uploaded through [url=https://smapi.io/log]https://smapi.io/log[/url].[/*]
[/list]Screenshots are especially helpful for tooltip-related issues.
